claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with Nikon branding, but the exact model number (D610) is not readable from the provided angles.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera body, but the report does not provide clear, close condition details (scratches/dents) to confirm or contradict cosmetic wear.

claims.claim: Comes with original battery and charger.
claims.evidence: No photos show the battery/charger or included accessories.
No shutter count display or camera menu/screen is shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: Lens glass condition (fungus/haze/scratches) is not clearly shown; no close-up of the lens elements is included.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No service history, proof of originality, or repair documentation is shown.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be D610 (could be another Nikon DSLR), which changes market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/number from the body (e.g., on the top/bottom label) and/or the 'About/Model' screen in the camera menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified Nikon DSLR body (worst-case generic DSLR value) until the exact model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Not all accessories may be included (battery/charger/memory card/strap/box).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included items laid out (battery, charger, cables, strap, memory card) with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body with unknown completeness (worst-case missing charger or battery) until accessories are confirmed.

risks.risk: Functional status unknown (may not power on, shutter may fail, buttons/ports may be faulty).
risks.proof: Video clip: power on, menu navigation, rear LCD display, autofocus attempt, and a short shutter test (a few shots) with timestamps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (fungus, haze, scratches, aperture issues) affecting image quality.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens glass under light (including aperture blades view if possible) plus a short video of aperture/focus behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition uncertain (worst-case for haze/fungus) until close-ups confirm cleanliness.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be inaccurate.
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count from a reliable method (camera menu if available or a shutter-count app screen) showing the number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher usage/unknown shutter count until the shutter count is verifiably shown.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (dents, cracks, worn mounts/ports) not clearly verifiable from the provided angles.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of: lens mount area, hot shoe, ports (USB/HDMI), buttons/dials, and corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as moderate cosmetic wear until close-ups confirm the actual condition.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact model identifier (D610) from the camera body label or a menu 'About' screen.
Photos/video showing the included battery and charger (and any other accessories) laid out with the camera.
Video test: power on, menu navigation, autofocus attempt, and a short shutter test (a few shots) showing the LCD.
Close-up lens photos of front and rear glass under bright light to check for fungus/haze/scratches.
A screenshot/photo showing shutter count from a reliable method.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR, but the exact model (D610), accessory completeness, shutter count, lens condition, and working status are not verifiable from the provided images. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
